# Virtual Velocity

This file summarizes information published on the Virtual Velocity website. Use the linked pages for the most current details.

Website: https://www.thevirtualvelocity.com

## Services

The services page lists the following areas:

- Branding and visual identity
- Social media management
- Photography and videography
- Shopify store development
- Influencer marketing
- Search engine optimization
- Meta advertising and Google advertising
- Software development
- BPO and outsourcing
- Hotel, hospitality, and restaurant marketing

See [Services](https://www.thevirtualvelocity.com/services) for service descriptions and deliverables.

## About

The website identifies Tauseef Alam as Virtual Velocity's founder and describes work in digital marketing, content, social media, strategy, and digital communities.

See [About](https://www.thevirtualvelocity.com/about) for the published founder biography and [Owned Media](https://www.thevirtualvelocity.com/owned-media) for information about Rawalpindians, Islamabad Insider, and Sirf Chai.

## Process

The services page describes a four-stage delivery process: audit, strategy, execution, and scale.

## Frequently asked questions

### What services does Virtual Velocity list?

The site lists branding, social media, photography, videography, Shopify store development, influencer marketing, SEO, Meta and Google advertising, software development, BPO, and hospitality and restaurant marketing. See the [Services page](https://www.thevirtualvelocity.com/services).

### How does the delivery process work?

The services page describes the stages as audit, strategy, execution, and scale.

### Where can I find current contact and location details?

Use the [Contact page](https://www.thevirtualvelocity.com/contact) for the latest published details.

### Where can I read the agency's articles and case studies?

Browse the [Digital Journal](https://www.thevirtualvelocity.com/blog), the [Cresto Pizza branding case study](https://www.thevirtualvelocity.com/branding), and [The Salt Line case study](https://www.thevirtualvelocity.com/the-salt-line).

## Contact

For project enquiries, use the [Contact page](https://www.thevirtualvelocity.com/contact). The contact form requires a configured submission endpoint to deliver enquiries.
